verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a Consent Management feature to capture consent for GDPR/CCPA compliance, and its compliance toolkit claims consent preferences are continuously captured and synced downstream to every tool in the stack. The evidence is only short marketing and docs-index lines, with no detail showing how opt-outs or consent categories block or filter events per destination. Missing for 10: documented per-destination enforcement of consent categories, explicit evidence that opt-outs are automatically honored downstream, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
